subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should Control UI support persistent per-agent avatar uploads from the Agents tab, and should that be composed from existing agent file/update APIs or exposed as a new dedicated admin upload RPC?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but accepting arbitrary browser-selected image files into an agent workspace and mutating `IDENTITY.md` needs maintainer intent for storage location, auth scope, validation, and whether a new protocol method is warranted.

options.title: Add a bounded admin upload flow
options.body: Implement a constrained persistent avatar upload with explicit size/MIME/path validation, safe workspace writes, identity update, and Control UI/Gateway tests.

options.title: Reuse existing file and identity APIs
options.body: Avoid a new RPC and make the UI compose `agents.files.set` plus `agents.update` if maintainers accept that product shape and security boundary.

options.title: Keep browser-local override only
options.body: Do not add persistent workspace upload yet; keep the Quick Settings override and document manual `IDENTITY.md`/config paths until avatar display bugs settle.

recommendation.title: Add a bounded admin upload flow
recommendation.body: Implement a constrained persistent avatar upload with explicit size/MIME/path validation, safe workspace writes, identity update, and Control UI/Gateway tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Agents page and agent RPC handler blame both route to this recent area contributor, making them the best available owner for the boundary decision.
